files: contracts/paid-board/src/lib.rs (Board struct, new/migrate/upgrade), new src/migrate.rs, src/payments.rs (struct fields only)
goal:
Land the version-2 state layout and the migration, with no behaviour change. Spec: docs/payments/2026-11-01-paid-board-revision-spec.md §C7 and the 'Findings' section.

SCOPE
- Add state_version to Board (deployed layout = 1, this = 2).
- Add EVERY new top-level field the revision needs, at its default: Tunables fields for C1/C8/F1/F2 and distribution_interval_ns; Payments fields for separate price cooldowns, mPOO day counter, mpoo_undistributed, mpoo_staker_reserve, team_account, buyback_account, staking_contract (Option), last distribution times; Board fields first_fill_complete.
- New maps with NEW prefixes only: AccountExtra under b"a", free_cells under b"f". Never change the value type of p, h or c.
- migrate(team_account, buyback_account): #[private] #[init(ignore_state)], reads the v1 struct, writes v2, rejects any other version with UnsupportedStateVersion.
- upgrade(code, migrate_args): deploy + migrate in one promise batch.

ACCEPTANCE
- Test: a serialized v1 board with balances, painted cells, holders and outstanding credits migrates with every value unchanged.
- Test: migrate twice rejects; wrong version rejects.
- All 86 existing paid-board tests pass unchanged.

WHY FIRST
REV-B, REV-C and REV-D all add behaviour on these fields. Landing the layout once stops three branches colliding on the structs.

BEFORE YOU START
Read AGENT.md, docs/learning/traps.md and the spec section named above. Contract changes were approved by the owner on 1 Nov for this revision only, on testnet. Do not deploy to mainnet.

DONE MEANS
AGENT.md's definition of done: tests named that fail before and pass after, cargo test / npm test / npm run build as relevant, a '## Learned' line in the PR, and docs/backlog.md updated in the same PR.
